key_insight: SegWithU turns uncertainty estimation into a lightweight, post-hoc "perturbation energy" head added to a frozen segmentation backbone, enabling reliable risk-aware segmentation with a single forward pass.
problem_solved: Provides accurate, well-ranked failure/uncertainty estimates for medical image segmentation without costly repeated inference or restrictive feature-space assumptions.
method: Post-hoc design: attach a small uncertainty head to a frozen pretrained segmentation backbone (no re-training of the backbone required).
Uncertainty as perturbation energy: the head models sensitivity to learned perturbations and converts that response into pixel-wise uncertainty scores in one forward pass.
Risk-aware output: combine segmentation logits with the perturbation-energy uncertainty map to rank failures and guide downstream decision thresholds or human review.
impact: Delivers practical, low-cost uncertainty estimates that integrate easily into existing segmentation pipelines—helping practitioners detect likely failures and prioritize human review in clinical workflows without large compute overhead.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: frozen segmentation backbone + lightweight uncertainty head, showing single-forward-pass data flow.
Heatmap overlay examples: segmentation mask vs. perturbation-energy uncertainty map highlighting failure regions.
Bar or ROC-style chart: failure-detection ranking performance comparing single-pass SegWithU to repeated-inference baselines (e.g., MC Dropout) and prior single-pass methods.
Clinical workflow sketch: automated segmentation -> uncertainty-based triage -> human review/automatic acceptance
paper_title: SegWithU: Uncertainty as Perturbation Energy for Single-Forward-Pass Risk-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
paper_authors: Tianhao Fu, Austin Wang, Charles Chen, Roby Aldave-Garza, Yucheng Chen
